content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up your online store and start accepting payments for your digital products without the hassles of payment restrictions. With COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit, you gain access to all the necessary components to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack efficiently. This means you can start selling eBooks, courses, and other digital creations within hours, not weeks. The infrastructure allows you to utilize cost-effective tools like Cloudflare, Supabase, and NOWPayments, ensuring that your products are delivered instantly and securely. By leveraging blockchain technology, you can transact in cryptocurrencies, bypassing the traditional financial systems that limit access for many Bangladeshi creators. The power to sell globally is at your fingertips once you deploy the Complete Builder Kit.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack for Bangladeshi freelancers consists of GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend processing, and NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. This combination allows you to establish a fully functional online store without incurring significant costs. GitHub Pages provides a reliable hosting solution that is free, while Google Apps Script enables efficient order management and product delivery. Incorporating NOWPayments ensures that you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. By utilizing these tools, you create a stack designed for sovereignty and scale, allowing you to maintain full ownership of your digital products and customer data. This stack forms the backbone of your online business, providing the essential infrastructure needed to thrive in a restricted payment landscape.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on what delivers immediate value and impact for your online business. Avoid getting bogged down in unnecessary details or features that can be added later. For instance, while advanced marketing strategies and customer tracking are beneficial, they are secondary to establishing a stable payment and delivery system. Concentrate on deploying your store, ensuring your product files are accessible, and confirming that payment processing works smoothly through NOWPayments. Once you have this foundation, you can gradually integrate additional features like email marketing or analytics tools. This approach allows you to start generating income immediately while refining your operations as your business grows. Prioritize actions that directly contribute to converting visitors into paying customers without distractions.
Empower your digital business with sovereign infrastructure today.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To live your first transaction, set up your store's basic structure and load it with the digital products you intend to sell. Start by deploying your GitHub Pages site or using Cloudflare Pages if you prefer an even more robust solution. Once your site is live, integrate NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Test the payment processing feature by making a small purchase yourself. This not only verifies that everything is functioning correctly but also gives you firsthand experience of the purchasing process. Ensure that order confirmations are automated and that product delivery is immediate via your chosen storage solution, like Google Drive. Once your first transaction is complete, you can confidently promote your offerings and scale operations, knowing your infrastructure is sound.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, implement your deployment plan by taking concrete steps to launch your online store. Begin by setting up your domain name with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare. Load your digital products into your chosen file storage service and connect it to your store. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. Reach out to your audience through social media channels or your existing networks to announce your launch. Also, consider crafting a simple promotional campaign to attract initial customers. Ensure that you have a process for managing customer inquiries and payment confirmations in place. This proactive approach will set a strong foundation for future success and establish your presence in the international market.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Set up a free GitHub Pages or Cloudflare account for hosting your online store. 2. Use Google Apps Script to handle backend transactions and order management. 3. Create a NOWPayments account to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. 4. Upload your digital products to a secure storage solution like Google Drive. 5. Integrate all components, ensuring payment processing works seamlessly. 6. Test your store by processing a small transaction to confirm everything is operational. 7. Announce your launch through social media or email networks, focusing on attracting initial customers.
